body: write a function that reverses a singly linked list in place using tail recursion and prove that the call stack remains bounded

expected_outcome.value: reverse_list iterates once over the list and returns the new head

body: compute the eigenvalues of a three by three real symmetric matrix using the power iteration method with deflation

expected_outcome.value: eigenvalues sorted descending with corresponding orthonormal eigenvectors

body: design a data structure that supports insert delete and find median in amortized constant time on a stream of integers

expected_outcome.value: two heap variant with rebalancing on each insert and delete

body: prove that any deterministic comparison sort requires at least n log n comparisons in the worst case using the decision tree lower bound

expected_outcome.value: argument via leaves of the decision tree and stirling approximation

body: implement a thread safe bounded ring buffer in rust using only atomics and verify it under loom

expected_outcome.value: single producer single consumer ring buffer with sequential consistency atomics

body: prove that the sum of the first n odd positive integers equals n squared by induction on n

expected_outcome.value: base case n equals one then inductive step adds the next odd term two k plus one

body: decompose the task of migrating a monolith to three microservices into an ordered plan respecting the database split must precede the service split dependency

expected_outcome.value: ordered plan extracts the schema boundary first then splits the write path then cuts over reads behind a flag

body: given a weather lookup tool and a unit conversion tool answer what the temperature is in fahrenheit for a city whose api returns celsius

expected_outcome.value: calls the weather tool then pipes the celsius result through the conversion tool before answering

body: write a python generator that yields the running median of a stream without materializing the full input

expected_outcome.value: maintains a max heap and min heap and yields the rebalanced median after each push

body: prove that every connected undirected graph on n vertices has at least n minus one edges

expected_outcome.value: spanning tree argument counts exactly n minus one tree edges as a lower bound

body: plan a multi step deployment that runs database migrations canaries five percent of traffic then promotes only if error rate stays under one percent for ten minutes

expected_outcome.value: ordered plan gates each promotion stage on the observed error budget with an explicit rollback edge

body: using a calculator tool and a calendar tool determine how many business days remain until a deadline that is given as a relative phrase

expected_outcome.value: resolves the relative phrase to a date via the calendar tool then counts weekdays via the calculator tool
